title: Fix Demonstrator Mobile Blurred Background on Card
description: On touch/mobile demonstrator overview, the live app behind each card must stay behind a full ui-veil blur instead of going clear when the section snaps settled.
summary:
## Summary
Touch demonstrator overview sections no longer drop the veil to opacity 0 when snapped — each card now sits over a fully opaque `ui-veil` so the live pane stays blurred (desktop-style hover reveal is unchanged).

### Root cause
`demonstratorListVeilOpacity(0)` returned 0 for the settled section, matching desktop hover-reveal but leaving the running app sharp behind the glass card on mobile.

### Fix
Replaced scroll-driven veil fade with constant `DEMONSTRATOR_MOBILE_OVERVIEW_VEIL_OPACITY = 1` while `showOverviewLayer` is true; focused panes still hide the veil.

### Files
- `♻️mit-bestand/🧺️demonstrator/📦️index.tsx`
